native_notify_capture_failed: Title of the system notification shown when a screenshot or recording could not be made; the body says why.
native_notify_dock_agent_gone: Error the agent dock shows when the agent it was about to send text to has gone away.
native_notify_dock_keys_clash: Error under the agent dock's key settings when both shortcuts are the same.
native_notify_dock_not_built: Error returned to the page when it asks for the dock's right-click menu and the dock window does not exist.
native_notify_no_home: Error under the shell setting when Atlas cannot find the user's home folder to save the choice in.

native_notify_no_permission.description: Body of the notification, and error on the capture card, when macOS has not granted Screen Recording to Atlas. The panel names are the ones of macOS.

native_notify_shell_not_executable: Error under the shell setting when the chosen file cannot be run. {path} is what the person typed.
